metaDescription: Order custom Case Logic laptop cases in bulk with your logo. Durable, padded protection for your brand. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Case Logic laptop cases combine reliable padded protection with a clean, professional look that suits corporate giveaways and employee onboarding kits. These cases feature durable nylon exteriors and organization pockets for accessories, making them practical for daily commutes or trade show travel. Choose from sizes that fit 13 to 17 inch laptops and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a polished branded impression.
